Layer: `ext`. Role: support/implementation data. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Implementation support for the weighted/higher moment family. Bounded binary64 mantissa products and quotients defer power-of-two scaling until the end; input validation precedes zero handling. Both registered runtime tests pass on Linux x86_64 in 7.31 seconds. The independent Fraction model covers 1,926 cases over all six helpers, including 1,122 exact-bit cases; the maximum observed distance is two ULPs. Not arbitrary precision, an exactly rounded fused product or a standalone estimator; supported workflows and finite accuracy/target limits follow the linked guides.
